returns.pages: the number of wasm pages (2^16 bytes)

returns.price: the amount of ink 1 gas buys

returns.depth: the maximum depth (in wasm words) a wasm stack may grow

returns.cached: amount of gas in increments of 64 when cached
returns.gas: amount of gas in increments of 256 when not cached
base amount of gas needed to grow another wasm page

returns.ramp: bits representing the floating point value

returns.gasWhenCached: the amount of gas if the program was recently used

returns.footprint: the memory footprint of program in pages (reverts for EVM contracts)

returns._secs: the time left in seconds (reverts for EVM contracts)

returns.version: the program version (reverts for EVM contracts)

blockCacheSize().notice: Gets the number of extra programs ArbOS caches during a given block.

codehashAsmSize(bytes32).notice: Gets a program's asm size. Reverts if program is not active.

codehashKeepalive(bytes32).notice: Extends a program's expiration date. Reverts if too soon or if the program is not up to date.

codehashVersion(bytes32).notice: Gets the stylus version the program with codehash was most recently activated against

expiryDays().notice: Gets the number of days after which programs deactivate

freePages().notice: Gets the number of free wasm pages a program gets

initCostScalar().notice: Gets the linear adjustment made to program init costs.

inkPrice().notice: Gets the conversion rate between gas and ink

keepaliveDays().notice: Gets the age a program must be to perform a keepalive

maxStackDepth().notice: Gets the wasm stack size limit

minInitGas().notice: Gets the minimum costs to invoke a program

pageGas().notice: Gets the base cost of each additional wasm page (2^16 bytes)

pageLimit().notice: Gets the maximum number of pages a wasm may allocate

pageRamp().notice: Gets the ramp that drives exponential memory costs

programInitGas(address).notice: Gets the cost to invoke the program

programMemoryFootprint(address).notice: Gets the memory footprint of the program at the given address in pages

programTimeLeft(address).notice: Gets the amount of time remaining until the program expires

programVersion(address).notice: Gets the stylus version the program was most recently activated against
